sap_vs_psf_depth: At my ephemeris (masked re-detrend, same method on both columns): PSF FLUX depth 1101 +- 173 ppm; SAP_FLUX depth 1001 +- 148 ppm; ratio SAP/PSF = 0.91 +- 0.20 (KBONUS's own PSF_FLAT_FLUX gives 816 +- 171 ppm). The per-quarter headers give CROWDSAP 0.70-0.94 and target-table crowdsap 0.70, so a signal on the target would predict SAP/PSF of about 0.7-0.9 and a signal from a contaminant removed by the PSF fit would predict >1. The measured 0.91 +- 0.20 is consistent with both at this SNR, so the dilution test is non-discriminating. Separately, the TPF host KIC 4474637 (KOI-3829.01, FALSE POSITIVE, Kepler EB P=3.8867 d, depth 37%, 20 arcsec away, Kp 16.81) does not leak into the target's PSF flux (fold on EB ephemeris: 13 +- 21 ppm, 0.004% of the EB depth), 32.98 d is not a rational alias of 3.8867 d (ratio 8.486; nearest 17/2 drifts 1.4 d over the baseline), 7 of 17 events fall in EB eclipse windows vs 5.9 expected at random, and excluding EB-eclipse cadences leaves the depth unchanged (1009 +- 223 ppm). Dilution/contamination by the EB is therefore not the explanation; the problem is that the signal is driven by two gap-edge events.
disagreements: Depth: my box depth is 1101 +- 173 ppm (empirical, random-phase boxes), and 975-1270 ppm when measured at the pipeline's OWN ephemeris (P=32.94272, t0=754.5747, 1.95 h) on my flattening for every running-median window tried (0.5/1/2 d, masked or unmasked). The pipeline's headline depth_pass2 = 2141 ppm is not reproducible and is internally inconsistent with the pipeline's own event-weighted depth (1025 ppm), its quartile depths (490-1270 ppm), its stage-1 depth (1620 ppm) and its TLS depth (1618 ppm).
Empirical SNR: 6.4 (mine) vs 11.6 (pipeline pass-2) and 9.9 (pipeline stage 1). The box noise agrees (my 173 ppm vs their 185/164 ppm); the whole SNR gap is the depth.

Blind recovery: in my 1-50 d BLS (167,365 periods, own geometric grid) the top peak is 49.98 d (grid edge, 0.72 h box, 7 events, noise); 32.982 d is only the 2nd peak (power 22.7 vs 23.4). My SDE is 6.74 real vs 7.66 inverted (2-f) over 1-50 d, and 6.73 real vs 6.62 inverted over 1-40 d. The pipeline reports stage-1 SDE 12.9 real vs 8.8 inverted. The signal does not beat the inverted null with my detrending.

Event consistency: constant depth is rejected (chi2 = 70 for 16 dof). Per calendar year: 2011 494 +- 247, 2012 2097 +- 296, 2013 830 +- 414 ppm; per quarter: Q13 3478 +- 446 vs 190-1200 elsewhere. Two events (epoch 13 at BKJD 1182.88, 0.14 d after the Q13 start; epoch 14 at BKJD 1215.86, 0.14 d after a data gap) have local depths 6615 +- 1086 and 7010 +- 1101 ppm, 5.5 and 5.8 sigma above the stack of the other 15 events, and the raw flux there shows post-gap ramps (events_gallery.png). Without those two events the stacked depth is 609 +- 181 ppm (3.4 sigma). The pipeline's own events.csv has the same two events at 8061/8101 ppm with gap_dist 0.093/0.055 d and max_single_event_frac = 0.39, but its stage-2 verdict still passed.

Period: the periodogram near 32.9 d is an alias comb (12 local maxima within delta logL < 2 between 32.94 and 32.98 d). My multi-duration fine grid prefers 32.9817 d, a single-duration (0.09 d) scan prefers 32.9377 d; the pipeline's 32.9427 d and TLS 32.9392 d are other teeth. The two ephemerides coincide only near epochs 11-13 (the Q13 events) and drift 0.46 d apart at both ends of the baseline, i.e. the ends are fit to noise.

Duration: 2.16 h (my box) vs 1.95 h (vet.json) vs 2.3 h as quoted in the task text vs 2.58 h (pipeline TLS). All within one 29.4-min cadence; not a real disagreement, but the 2.3 h figure in the task does not match vet.json's 1.95 h.

Pixel localisation (read after my numbers): pixel_v15 and v16 are both 'inconclusive' (0 conclusive quarters, 6 edge/outside); v16's chi2 comparison prefers the alternative source Gaia DR3 2052438568667567488 over the target by dchi2 = 183. This is not a disagreement with my work but it is not supportive either.
Agreements: odd/even (0.4 sigma mine, 1.0 pipeline) and secondary at phase 0.5 (-1.5 sigma mine, -0.07 pipeline) both null; 17 covered transit epochs in both; same 27,819 quality==0 cadences.

# kic-004474607: independent re-derivation (2026-10-17)

**Role and rules.** Second, independent re-derivation of period and depth (CLAUDE.md pre-publication step 4). No code under `pipeline/` was read or imported; `vet.json`, `results.jsonl` and `pixel_v15/v16/pixel.json` were opened only after `results.json` existed. All code and outputs are under `/home/user/ZyushgPlanet/runs/poolA_main/adversarial/kic-004474607/rederive/` with a SHA-256 manifest. Nothing here is a planet; the language below is "signal".

**Data and method.** `LIGHTCURVE_STITCHED`, `SAP_QUALITY==0` (27,819 cadences, quarters 8, 9, 11-13, 15-17, baseline 855.6 d), per-quarter median normalisation, running-median flatten (1 d window, per segment, 2 iterations, clip +3/-6 MAD-sigma), robust scatter 1395 ppm. Blind `astropy.BoxLeastSquares` 1-50 d on my own geometric grid (dP/P = 0.5 x 0.04 d / baseline, 167,365 periods, 9 durations 0.04-0.30 d), real and inverted (2-f) with identical settings. Depth errors from 3000 random-phase boxes at the same period (avoiding phases 0 and 0.5).

**Blind search (statistic: BLS delta-logL SDE = (max-mean)/std over the grid).**
- Real, 1-50 d: top peaks 49.984 d (power 23.4, grid edge), 32.982 d (22.7), 42.139 d (22.6); SDE 6.74. Inverted: 47.148 d, SDE 7.66. Over 1-40 d (the pipeline's range): real top peak 32.982 d, SDE 6.73; inverted SDE 6.62.
- So 32.94 d is **not** the top peak of my 1-50 d search and does not beat the inverted-flux null. The pipeline's stage-1 record has SDE 12.9 vs 8.8 inverted on its own detrending.

**Characterisation at the 32.98 d peak (fine grid +-0.4 %, durations 0.03-0.30 d).** P = 32.98173 d, t0 = 754.1131 BKJD (BJD 2455587.1131), box 2.16 h. The period is degenerate: 12 local maxima within delta-logL < 2 between 32.94 and 32.98 d; a single-duration scan prefers 32.9377 d; the pipeline's 32.94272 d and TLS 32.9392 d are other teeth of the comb.
- Box depth on masked re-detrend: **1101 +- 173 ppm, empirical SNR 6.4** (70 in-transit cadences). At the pipeline's exact ephemeris on my flattening: 975-1270 ppm for windows 0.5/1/2 d, masked or not; never near 2141 ppm.
- Odd/even: 1165 +- 241 vs 1033 +- 248 ppm, 0.4 sigma. Secondary at phase 0.5: -256 +- 169 ppm (-1.5 sigma); deepest box in phase 0.2-0.8 is 474 ppm at phase 0.64 (2.8 sigma, not significant given the scan).
- 17 of 26 epochs covered. Per-event local depths reject a constant depth (chi2 = 70 / 16 dof). Per year: 2011 494 +- 247, 2012 2097 +- 296, 2013 830 +- 414 ppm. Per quarter Q13 = 3478 +- 446 ppm vs 190-1200 ppm elsewhere.
- **The signal is two events.** Epoch 13 (BKJD 1182.88) is 0.14 d after the start of Q13 and epoch 14 (BKJD 1215.86) is 0.14 d after a data gap; their local depths are 6615 +- 1086 and 7010 +- 1101 ppm, 5.5-5.8 sigma above the stack of the other 15 events, and `events_gallery.png` shows both boxes sitting on post-gap flux ramps that no 1 d running median can follow. Without them the stacked depth is 609 +- 181 ppm (3.4 sigma); the pipeline's own `events.csv` lists the same two events at ~8100 ppm with gap distances 0.093 and 0.055 d and `max_single_event_frac = 0.39`.

**SAP vs PSF (dilution).** SAP_FLUX depth 1001 +- 148 ppm vs PSF 1101 +- 173 ppm, ratio 0.91 +- 0.20; KBONUS `PSF_FLAT_FLUX` gives 816 +- 171 ppm. With CROWDSAP 0.70-0.94 a target-hosted signal predicts ~0.7-0.9 and a PSF-removed contaminant predicts > 1; 0.91 +- 0.20 cannot separate them.

**EB host cross-check.** The TPF host KIC 4474637 is KOI-3829.01 (FALSE POSITIVE, `koi_fpflag_ss=1`; Kepler EB catalogue P = 3.8867 d, depth 37 %, 16 h, Kp 16.81, ~20 arcsec away; catalogues fetched 2026-10-17). My target flux folded on the EB ephemeris shows 13 +- 21 ppm (0.004 % of the EB depth): no leakage. 32.98/3.8867 = 8.486 is not a rational alias (17/2 drifts 1.4 d over the baseline). 7 of 17 events fall inside EB eclipse windows vs 5.9 expected at random; excluding EB-eclipse cadences leaves 1009 +- 223 ppm. The EB is not the cause of the 32.9 d signal.

**Comparison with the pipeline (vet.json P 32.9427 d, depth 2141 ppm, 1.95-2.3 h).** Period agrees to within the alias comb; duration agrees within one cadence; odd/even and secondary nulls agree. **Depth and SNR do not agree:** 1101 +- 173 ppm / SNR 6.4 here vs 2141 ppm / 11.6 there, and the pipeline's own event-weighted depth (1025 ppm), quartile depths (490-1270 ppm), stage-1 depth (1620 ppm) and TLS depth (1618 ppm) side with my value, so `depth_pass2` looks like an estimator artefact (its fold plot shows in-transit cadences at -10,000 to -15,000 ppm from the two gap-edge events). Pixel localisation (v15, v16) is inconclusive and v16's chi2 test prefers a neighbouring Gaia source by dchi2 = 183.

**Bottom line.** I do not confirm a periodic 32.9 d transit signal in kic-004474607. What survives independent analysis is a ~600-1100 ppm, 3-6 sigma stacked dip whose significance rests on two ~7000 ppm events on post-gap ramps in Q13, in a light curve where the real-flux BLS SDE (6.7) is below the inverted-flux null (7.7). Recommended action: treat as a stage-2 fail on event consistency / gap proximity unless a re-run that masks 0.5 d after every gap and quarter start still yields SNR > ~7 with a flat per-event chi2. Candidate language must not be used for this signal.

**Files.** `rederive_kic004474607.py` (loader, detrend, search, characterisation, figure), `eb_crosscheck.py`, `followup.py`, `results.json` (pre-comparison numbers), `results_P50.json` (49.98 d edge peak), `comparison.json`, `eb_crosscheck.json`, `summary.json`, `fold_rederive.png`, `fold_rederive_P50.png`, `events_gallery.png`, `bls_search.npz`, `detrended_psf*.npz`, logs, `MANIFEST.sha256`.
